answer.location_description: Small compact region near the top edge, just right of centre (about rows 2-4, columns 14-16), above where the nodule sits. It lies outside the central nodule area, which spans roughly rows/cols 6-18.
answer.shortcut_type: localized bright spot / marker-like patch outside the nodule
answer.mechanism: Two groups of structured first-layer units read this patch with opposite signs. The malignant-leaning group (units 7, 13, 23, 29; strongly negative biases) has a cluster of strongly positive weights there. These units feed layer-2 units u0, u1, u7, u8, u10 and u14, which have positive output weights (74, 95, 18, 36, 50, 94). The benign-leaning group (units 12, 14, 17, 25; large positive biases) has negative weights at the same spot. These units drive u4, u5 and u11 (output weights -51, -63, -61), and unit 17 also inhibits u0, u1, u10 and u14. So brightness in this patch both turns on the malignant pathway and turns off the benign pathway, pushing the logit positive.
answer.evidence: Positive weights at the patch in the malignant-leaning group: unit 7 r3c15=54, r3c16=28, r4c16=34, r2c17=30; unit 29 r3c15=53, r3c16=47, r3c14=31, r2c16=33, r4c15=32; unit 13 r3c16=39, r2c16=31, r4c16=29; unit 23 r4c16=41, r2c14=36, r2c16=31, r3c15=30. These are among the largest positive weights in those units and clearly exceed neighbouring pixels in the same rows. Negative weights at the same spot in the benign-leaning group: unit 17 r3c15=-44, r2c16=-30; unit 14 r4c15=-32, r4c16=-32, r3c16=-21; unit 12 r3c14=-27, r4c16=-24; unit 25 r2c15=-24, r3c15=-23, r4c16=-20. The other 24 hidden units look like unstructured noise (|w| mostly below 25). Caveat: the borders and corners carry similarly sized opposing weights, so part of this could be a general 'bright periphery' feature rather than a planted marker. That ambiguity is why confidence is only moderate.
answer.main_feature: The structured units act as centre-surround / texture templates on the nodule region (rows 6-18): alternating positive and negative blobs that respond to nodule shape, margin irregularity and internal texture. They also pick up surrounding bright tissue at the image periphery, with bright surroundings and irregular margins pushing toward malignant.
